Package com.nexuslink.protocol.grpc

Class GrpcService

java.lang.Object
com.nexuslink.protocol.grpc.GrpcService
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public final class GrpcService extends Object implements AutoCloseable
Dynamic gRPC client driven entirely by server reflection — no .proto upload needed. Lists services/methods, builds request messages from JSON, invokes unary methods, and prints the response as JSON. Server-, client- and bidirectional-streaming methods are invocable through openStream(String, String, StreamListener).

    • connect

      public void connect(String host, int port, boolean tls, TlsConfig tlsConfig)
      Connects with optional custom TLS material. When tls is false the channel is plaintext. When tls is true and tlsConfig is custom, a netty client SSL context is built from the configured trust store (the CAs to verify the server) and/or client key store (a client certificate for mutual TLS), or trust-all; otherwise the system default TLS is used.

    • openStream

      public GrpcService.StreamCall openStream(String service, String method, GrpcService.StreamListener listener) throws Exception
      Opens a streaming call (server, client, or bidirectional). The call is driven with the bidi machinery in every case — for server streaming, send one request then GrpcService.StreamCall.halfClose(); for client streaming the single response arrives through listener before completion.
      Throws:
      Exception
